# Utilizing `dbplyr` to visualize my database 
```{r}
# Set-up 
# Establish connection to database
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(),
                       dbdir = "../threatened_sa.duckdb")

# View tables in database 
DBI::dbListTables(conn)
```

# Analytical question
**What country has the most species occurrences that fall inside protected areas?**

## SQL query 
```{sql connection=conn}

  SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(*) as total_occurrences FROM occurrences o
    JOIN protection_status ps ON o.species_id = ps.species_id
    JOIN countries c ON o.country_code = c.country_code
    WHERE ps.in_protected_area = TRUE
    GROUP BY o.country_code, c.country_name
    ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC;

```

## Replicate SQL query in R
```{r}
# Step 1: Extract the dataframes used for this join
occurrences_db <- tbl(conn, "occurrences")
protected_areas_db <- tbl(conn, "protected_areas")
countries_db <- tbl(conn, "countries")
protection_status_db <- tbl(conn, "protection_status")

# Query database to get total species occurrences in protected areas by country
pa_ranked_db <- occurrences_db %>%
  # Join protection status
  inner_join(protection_status_db, by = "species_id") %>%
  # Join countries to get country names
  inner_join(countries_db, by = "country_code") %>%
  # Keep only occurrences that fall inside a protected area
  filter(in_protected_area == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(country_code, country_name) %>%
  # Count total occurrences 
  summarise(total_occurrences = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) %>%
  collect()

# View the dataframe 
View(pa_ranked_db)

```

## Visualize 
```{r}
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
##  ~ Set-Up  ----
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# Add custom font
font_add_google("Spectral", "spectral")
showtext_auto()

# Colors 
gbif_green <- "#76b376"
background <- "#222222"

##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
##  ~ Bar-Chart  ----
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
occurrences_country_plot <- pa_ranked_db %>% 
  # Create highlight for Chile
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(country_name == "Chile", "Chile", "Other")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country_name, total_occurrences), 
             y = total_occurrences,
             fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  # Add text highlight of Chile occurrences
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(country_name == "Chile"),
            aes(label = scales::comma(total_occurrences)),
            hjust = 1.1, color = "white", family = "spectral", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chile" = gbif_green, "Other" = "grey70")) +  
  # Adjust scales 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1500000, by = 500000), 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +  
  # Flip x and y 
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Species Occurrences",
       title = "Where are threatened species most recorded in protected areas?",
       subtitle = "Chile records the highest species occurrences across 268 protected areas.",
       caption = "Data Sources: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA)\nGlobal Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)\nInternational Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
   theme(text = element_text(family = "spectral"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral", size = 15),
         axis.text.y = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral", size = 15), 
         axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral", size = 15), 
        plot.margin = margin(20, 80, 20, 20),
        legend.position = "none", 
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral",size = 22, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
        plot.subtitle =  element_text(color = "grey70", family = "spectral", margin = margin(t = 10)),
        plot.caption = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral",size = 10, margin = margin(t = 13),
                                    hjust = 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = background),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = background),
    )
occurrences_country_plot

# Save plot as png 
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

ggsave(here("figures", "bar_chart.png"), 
       plot = occurrences_country_plot, 
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Get SA country geometries
sa_map <- ne_countries(continent = "South America", returnclass = "sf")

# Join with your query results
map_data <- sa_map %>%
  left_join(pa_ranked_db, by = c("iso_a2" = "country_code"))

# Plot
occurences_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = map_data %>% filter(iso_a2 != "CL"), 
          aes(fill = total_occurrences), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = map_data %>% filter(iso_a2 == "CL"), 
          fill = gbif_green, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "grey30", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Where Are Endangered Species Being Protected?",
       fill = "Total Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "abyssinica"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
         axis.text.y = element_blank(),
         plot.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "spectral",size = 15, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "spectral", color = "white"),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "spectral", color = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = background, color = NA))
  
occurences_map

  # Save plot as png 
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("figures", "map.png"), 
       plot = occurences_map, 
       width = 16, 
       height = 11,
       dpi = 300)

```
